editorial:
Imagine a world where a legendary comedy star like Don Knotts totally loses his cool. You get to see him play a washed-up actor who just wants one last shot at fame in the movie Newsies. When the director kicks him off the lot, he doesn't just walk away. Instead, he decides that if he can't be in the show, nobody gets to be. It is a wild mix of silly comedy and scary slasher vibes that feels like a bad dream on a movie set. You will find yourself laughing at how absurd the whole thing is while wondering how far he will go.

What really makes this work is seeing Don Knotts play against his usual nervous persona. The kills are creative and surprising, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. If you like campy horror, you will love this weird ride. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is the kind of flick that is even better when you share it with friends who love strange cinema.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Don Knotts is cornered on the Newsie Square set. He tries to kill the remaining cast, but the newsies team up to fight back. He ends up falling into a giant prop pile, which crushes him in a funny but dark way. The movie ends with the director finally getting his film finished, though he is traumatized. It wraps up as a dark joke about the price of fame.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird horror and old school comedy stars.
